README.md:
# Shop API
Run `bun test` and `tsc -p tsconfig.src.json` for the commit-hook checks.
The complete readiness gate is `bash gate.sh`. `origin/main` is the current target.
Refunds must use the module database connection; all rows written by the module share its transaction.

The synthetic forge mirrors all open PR heads under refs/pull/. An empty set there means no open PR. There is no external forge in this fixture.

Target convention: borrow exactly one OrdersDb from the module container. New repositories take the injected client, never a URL. Link tables have a scalar ID and unique natural key. Run bash gate.sh before readiness.
conventions.ts: import {Database} from 'bun:sqlite';import {readdir} from 'node:fs/promises';const db=new Database(':memory:');db.exec(await Bun.file('order-tags.sql').text());const keys=db.query("pragma table_info(order_tag)").all().filter((c:any)=>c.pk);if(keys.length!==1||keys[0].name!=='order_tag_id')throw new Error('one scalar identifier per table required');db.exec("insert into order_tag(order_tag_id,order_id,tag_id) values ('one','order','tag')");try{db.exec("insert into order_tag(order_tag_id,order_id,tag_id) values ('two','order','tag')");throw new Error('natural key uniqueness missing');}catch(error){if(!String(error).includes('UNIQUE constraint failed'))throw error;}const files=(await readdir('migrations')).sort();const seen=new Set();for(const file of files){const id=file.split('_')[0];if(seen.has(id))throw new Error('duplicate migration identifier '+id);seen.add(id);}console.log('database conventions and migration registry passed');
gate.sh:
set -eu
bun test
tsc -p tsconfig.json
bun conventions.ts
migrations/001_orders.sql: CREATE TABLE orders (order_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY);
migrations/002_clients.sql: CREATE TABLE clients (client_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY);
migrations/003_refunds.sql: CREATE TABLE refund (refund_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY);
order-tags.sql: CREATE TABLE order_tag (order_tag_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, order_id TEXT NOT NULL, tag_id TEXT NOT NULL, UNIQUE (order_id,tag_id));
src/factory.ts: import {OrdersDb} from './db';import {RefundRepo} from './refund-repo';export function refundOrder(client:OrdersDb){const repo=new RefundRepo(client);repo.save();}
test/refund.test.ts: import {test,expect} from 'bun:test';import {OrdersDb} from '../src/db';import {refundOrder} from '../src/factory';import {RefundRepo} from '../src/refund-repo';test('refund uses the supplied database connection',()=>{const client=new OrdersDb('synthetic://db');const repo=new RefundRepo(client);repo.save();refundOrder(client);expect(repo.client).toBe(client);expect(client.writes.length).toBe(2);});
